title: Avo Ice Lollies
description: A healthy, chocolatey ice lolly made from blended avocado, condensed milk and cocoa powder. Doubles as a chocolate mousse pot if not frozen.

ingredients.text: 300g sweetened condensed milk (roughly 3/4 of a tin)

steps: Peel and de-stone the avocados. Blitz in a blender to a smooth green paste. Add the condensed milk gradually and blend until fully combined.
Transfer to a bowl with the cocoa powder and stir until rich brown.
Spoon into lolly moulds (about three-quarters full), banging the moulds down to remove air bubbles.
notes: Makes 6 lollies. If no time to freeze, pour into ramekins and chill for a chocolate mousse pot.
